name: Littmann Classic II S.E. Lightweight Stethoscope, Black
seoTitle: Littmann Classic II S.E. Stethoscope Gift
metaDescription: The Littmann Classic II S.E. lightweight stethoscope in black, a dependable starter gift for nursing students heading into clinicals and for new grads.
summary: A lightweight Littmann is a classic first real stethoscope, a gift that carries a nursing student from skills lab through clinicals and into their first job.
whyItWorks: Many nursing students start with a cheap stethoscope from a school kit and then dream of upgrading to a Littmann. The Classic II S.E. is a common first step into the brand, and its lightweight build matters when a stethoscope hangs around the neck through a full clinical day or a 12 hour shift.

Gifting one before clinicals shows real support for a student's goals, and it makes a strong pinning or graduation gift for a new grad heading to med surg, telemetry, or a step down unit. Black is a safe, professional color that matches any scrub color a hospital might require. A stethoscope is personal and gets daily use, so it becomes a reminder of who believed in them early on. Add an ID tag with their name, since stethoscopes have a way of wandering off at the nurses station, and consider a protective case for the trips between home and the hospital.
goodToKnow: Add a name tag or engraving, since stethoscopes often get mixed up at work.

faq.q: Is this a good stethoscope gift for a nursing student?
faq.a: Yes. It is a well known starter Littmann that many students use through school and into their first nursing job.

faq.q: Which is better as a gift, this or the Cardiology IV?
faq.a: The Classic II S.E. suits students and general floor nurses, while the Cardiology IV is more of a big milestone or specialty upgrade gift.
